# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- Project security requirement: any elevated Warden/admin mode must be owner-only, configured locally, and application-level rather than granting Discord Administrator to the bot.
- The game server is named "The Forgotten Ring," and the Discord community/server is called "Aeloria." The world/lore identity is also "Aeloria" unless specified otherwise.

## Development Instructions
- When asked to resume or build the project, implement the changes in the workspace and validate them instead of only describing the work.
- When the user provides a copied GitHub URL or username, treat it as authoritative and do not correct or alter the spelling based on assumptions.
- Warden is intended as a broad local assistant and chatbot, Discord server builder/manager, and general-purpose jack-of-all-trades for the Aeloria community, while retaining owner-only elevated controls.- When the user provides a copied GitHub URL or username, treat it as authoritative and do not correct or alter the spelling based on assumptions.
